children: PharmaCyte Biotech amended its securities arrangements with Q/C Technologies, setting a 49.99% beneficial ownership limit on conversions of its Q/C preferred stock and exercises of certain warrants. Separately, PharmaCyte had consented to extend the maturity of Q/C's Series H preferred stock to September 2, 2027. Together, the amendments establish conversion and exercise limits while extending the Series H stock's maturity.
